title: Look Before You Leap
brief:
Until now you have read the terrain yourself and written the matching moves. Now let your code read it:

  • wall_right() — True when a step blocks the tile directly to your right, False when the way is clear.
  • wall_left() — the same, to your left.

An if statement runs its block only when the condition is True; the else block runs when it is False:

for step in range(7):
    if wall_right():
        jump_right()
    else:
        right()

Seven moves, and the code decides for itself which move each one should be.
